evidence: Adds C API functions and C++ wrapper headers in src/kernel/ and kernel test coverage for script execution tracing.
rationale: Exposes intermediate script execution states to libbitcoinkernel consumers for debuggers and visualizers. The PR adds an optional compile-time API that downstream tools (such as rust-bitcoinkernel) can build on, but it is an opt-in debugging extension rather than core block validation or chainstate functionality, making it worthwhile but deferrable.
